claim: Actual global completed-character Q-morphism with exact whole-chart restrictions

obligations.name: Source hypotheses
obligations.binding: ContactGlobalSmooth318.cover units is the actual open cover of the full normalization.

obligations.name: Constructed objects
obligations.binding: Source is ContactGlobalSmooth318.Model units; Target i is WeierstrassGluing318.scheme (publishedA i) (publishedB i).

obligations.name: Domain and index coverage
obligations.binding: All Fin 4 characters; both Bool source charts and all four ordered chart pairs.

obligations.name: Transition and comparison maps
obligations.binding: ContactFullOverlap318.actual_pullback and CompletedCharacterSchemeMaps318.maps_agree give compatibility on the canonical pullback through the specified isomorphism.

obligations.name: Identity of consumed object
obligations.binding: The local finite map is exactly the existing published source map; local infinity map is the exact regular map already frozen. completedMap restricts to both.

obligations.name: Coefficient conventions
obligations.binding: No new coordinate choices; the fixed source twists and published A/B from the two predecessor packets are unchanged.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.binding: Finite and infinity maps are defined on the whole charts. No local regularity is inferred merely from function-field formulas.

obligations.name: Exceptional cases
obligations.binding: The diagonal pullbacks use the proved open-immersion monomorphisms, both off-diagonal pairs use the actual pullback and its flip. No chart or character is dropped.

obligations.name: Downstream consumption
obligations.binding: Constructs completedMap, full on_finite/on_infinity, over_Q and uniqueness. Properness, surjectivity, relative-normalization/Jacobian/PEL comparisons remain separate.
